title: A stopped assembly line
passage:
Why has assembly line two stopped?
A. The second shift starts at six. B. A safety sensor needs replacing. C. We ordered two spare parts.
passageZh:
二號組裝線為什麼停下來了？
A. 第二班六點開始。
B. 一個安全感測器需要更換。
C. 我們訂了兩個備用零件。
audioScript:
